question: Which country has virtually hosted the 12th BRICS summit in November 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __Russia__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Russia has hosted the 12th BRICS summit held virtually on November 17, 2019.
 
• The theme of this year’s BRICS summit was ‘BRICS Partnership for Global Stability, Shared Security and Innovative Growth’.
 
• Global Concerns like Terrorism, UNSC security reforms, and the covid-19 pandemic were the main centres of discussion for the summit.
 
• The Ufa Declaration, adopted five years ago to deal with the spread of infectious diseases was also highlighted amidst this pandemic situation.
 
• PM Narendra Modi also discussed the Atmanirbhar Bharat campaign of India and how India has delivered the relevant medicines to different countries of the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

__
 
• About BRICS :

 
 
• BRICS refers to a grouping of 5 countries - Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa.
 
• These countries account for a total of:
 
 
• 42% of the population.
 
• 23% of GDP.
 
• 30% of the territorial area.
 
• 18% of Global Trade.
 
 
 
• British Economist Jim O'Neill Goldman Sachs coined the term BRIC in 2001 for the four countries with good growth namely Brazil, Russia, India, and China.
 
• The first formal summit of BRICS Ministers was held in the year 2006.
 
• South Africa was invited to join the grouping in 2010 and the grouping was named BRICS.
 
• The chairmanship of the grouping is rotated to all the member nations and each country heads it for one year.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Russia:

 
 
• Russia the largest country in the world is located on both Asian and European continents.
 
• Its capital Moscow is located in the European part of the country.
 
• Though 75% area of Russia is part of Asia its 75% population lives in the European part of Russia.
 
• It came into existence after the disintegration of the former USSR in 1991.
 
• Vladimir Putin is the incumbent President and Mikhail Mishustin the Prime Minister of Russia.
 
• It is separated from the North American Continent by Bering Strait.
